newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in wk to Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in wk to Jan 13.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have slowed in the week ended January 13 to 0.4 percent from 1.1 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended Jan 13 Jan 6
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +1.1 +1.3
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
